description: Function glyphs visually checked in the installed QQ Music and NetEase Cloud Music desktop clients on 2026-11-16. Bundled locally as vectors, using QQ green (#31c27c) and NetEase red (#ec4141) from LIRA's existing platform palette without colored tiles; these are not original PNG assets.

verifiedLocations.personalized: Top-left recommendation navigation button, house outline when not hovered
verifiedLocations.radio: Left navigation radio button, broadcast waves
verifiedLocations.liked: Left navigation likes entry, heart outline
verifiedLocations.recent: Left navigation recent playback entry, clock outline

textOnly.daily: The homepage daily recommendation uses changing track artwork, not a standalone function glyph

qq.adaptations: Verified font outlines converted to SVG paths with original geometry preserved. No substitute glyph is assigned to text-only entries.

verifiedLocations.personalized: Left navigation recommendation entry, filled house
verifiedLocations.daily: Calendar badge on the homepage daily recommendation card
verifiedLocations.radio: Heartbeat control beside the liked-music navigation entry
verifiedLocations.liked: Left navigation liked-music entry, filled heart
verifiedLocations.recent: Left navigation recent playback entry, filled clock

netease.adaptations: Original SVG geometry preserved. Calendar date cutout separated from the calendar shell so the existing local date label can update at midnight. Fill follows currentColor; clip IDs namespaced. No substitute glyph is assigned to text-only entries.
